messages:
Ravi: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — captured agreed action items below. I started a small ownership matrix, pls ack and adjust timelines.

Sophia: Ack. Can we put the runbooks into a single canonical path? Last time people referenced two copies.

Ravi: Agreed. Owner: Sophia. Target: 2025-01-12. Path: s3://redwood-runbooks/dr/restore_v2.md (will mark canonical and add checksum).

Amir: I own multi-region routing tests. I'll run canary tests weekly for the next 4 weeks. Owner: Amir. First run: 2025-01-03.

Jess: Adding note: we saw a recurring pattern where KV cache evictions during warm-up caused errors. Action: add a pre-warm step in the failover playbook. Owner: Jess. Target: 2025-01-08.

Elaine: For backups: verify cross-region snapshot retention settings and restore smoke test. Owner: Elaine + infra. Ticket: INFRA-3421. Due: 2025-01-10.

Ravi: Game day schedule proposal: 2025-01-20 09:00 PST – simulate EU primary outage + failover to NA. @ops-bot please create the calendar invite and channel.

ops-bot: Created calendar event and channel #game-day-2025-01-20. Invite sent to owners.

Sophia: Can we add a checklist item to confirm TLS cert propagation in failover? We had a mismatch last time.

Amir: Added cert-checkstep to runbook under "pre-failover checks" with sample command:
```
openssl s_client -connect api.eu.redwood.internal:443 -servername api.redwood.com
```

Jess: Also flagging that dedicated pool autoscaler didn't scale fast enough in the simulation. Action: tune scale-up threshold + increase burst capacity to 30% for critical CLs. Owner: PlatformTeam. Ticket: PLAT-611.

Elaine: I'll own the restore run-through and will post logs to the runbook after smoke test.

Ravi: Thanks — let's aim for all owners to post status updates by EOD 2025-01-05. I'll aggregate and close action items. If you can't meet, ping me.

Sophia: acked. I'll add the canonical runbook PR and include a small checksum script.

Amir: ack. Will post initial canary results in channel by 2025-01-04.

Jess: ack. Opening PLAT-611 now.

Ravi: Final ask — please note any recurrence patterns you see in the ticket (same error codes, time windows). Helps for triage automation.

Amir: Noted — most recurrences are within 10–15 minutes after deployment windows.

Elaine: On backups, retention mismatch often due to manual snapshot deletion. I'll add automated retention enforcement.

Ravi: Great. Closing loop here. I'll post an owners matrix doc and ping tomorrow for any blockers. :thumbsup:
